verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and payments SaaS platform. Whether its source is open is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an open-source license, a public repository, or readable source code; the docs cover APIs, guides and an MCP server only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
